title: Goo
dek: A newcomer whose unfamiliar form briefly alarms Vaemyr before conversation restores the welcome.

facts.Recorded at: The Gate and road to Pristinia

sources: Gate chronicle · selected arrival and welcome scenes; January 2024–September 2026 posting records
body:
A person, not a monster

Goo speaks with Olokun near Scribonia’s study place at the Gate, introduces himself as a plasmoid and says he is new to the land. When Vaemyr arrives, he mistakes Goo for a threat and raises a crossbow. Olokun identifies Goo as a friend; Vaemyr lowers the weapon and apologises.

A warrior of the heart

Goo accepts the apology, explaining that there are many plasmoids where he comes from. He contrasts Scribonia’s mind with his own heart as a warrior’s strength. The exchange records a misunderstanding resolved without violence, rather than hostility made inevitable by an unfamiliar body.
